object.attr: derived: CF-S2. A sparse checkout leaves files out of the working copy, so a document loads without its links or isn't listed, and trace and coverage look complete. A sparse checkout that keeps each document folder whole stays allowed. Decided on 2026-11-10 (Q-S13).
object.description: If the folder Mellon is asked to open is a sparse checkout that leaves out a file of a document's folder at the latest commit, Mellon shall refuse the folder.
